# DragController

> Enables pointer-driven drag-and-drop with drop mode or slot-based reordering.

## Constructor

```ts
new DragController(host: HTMLElement, options?: DragOptions)
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Required | Description |
|--------|------|----------|-------------|
| `selector` | `string` | yes |  |
| `dropZoneSelector` | `string` | no |  |
| `axis` | `'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'both'` | no |  |
| `mode` | `'drop' | 'slot'` | no |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no |  |

## Events Dispatched

| Event | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| `ui-drag-start` | `{ item, index }` |
| `ui-drag-move` | `{ item, x, y }` |
| `ui-drag-over` | `{ item, index, insertBefore }` |
| `ui-drop` | `{ item, target, fromIndex, toIndex }` |
| `ui-drag-cancel` | `{ item }` |

## Methods

| Method |
|--------|
| `destroy()` |

## Usage

```ts
import { DragController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new DragController(element, { /* options */ });
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
